server_reads.what_the_server_does_with_a_date: A date that is sent is validated for ISO form at infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/intake/uploads.py:234-236 (type and length only) and at intake/portfolio.py:208-212 for a SHARES unit (date.fromisoformat). The CSV lane then requires each SHARES quote's as_of to equal price_date exactly (portfolio.py:250, quote as_of and currency and security key checked) and records price_date in the document options (portfolio.py:501). The template lane applies the same exact-date test at portfolio.py:403 and :479. The server prices share quantities only at the date it is given; it does not derive a date.
server_reads.what_the_server_does_without_a_price_dat: REFUSES. intake/portfolio.py:208-212: when a SHARES unit is present and price_date is None (the portal omits the member when the field is empty, see the portal prospect.ts:136), date.fromisoformat(None) raises TypeError and the code raises PortfolioRefused('PRICE_DATE_REQUIRED'). The CSV lane reaches it after resolve_prices is called with None (uploads.py:419-421); the call happens before freeze_parsed_portfolio (uploads.py:425). The template lane (uploads.py:586-587) gives valid_date False (portfolio.py:401-405), so every SHARES row answers SHARES_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE (portfolio.py:477-486). Test evidence that the refusal is intended: intake/tests/test_portfolio.py:144 self.assert_refused('PRICE_DATE_REQUIRED', parsed) for a SHARES parse with no price_date.
